job_list.job_description:
• Own strategic projects across the content, creator and affiliate space, and drive research to understand the pain points, behaviours and incentives of creators, affiliates and content consumers across our markets.
  • Analyse data, user feedback and local market performance to identify opportunities to improve the creator, affiliate and content experience, ensuring a seamless journey from onboarding to monetisation.
job_list.requirements:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from a reputable university, in any related major.
  • 3+ years of experience. Product management or management consulting is a plus.
  • Proven ability to structure and solve complex problems, collaborate across varied stakeholders and teams, and communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.
  • Strong analytical and logical thinking, with a data-driven approach.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented and comfortable with ambiguity and change in a fast-paced environment.

job_list.job_description:
• Lead and drive the strategic analysis and optimization of end-to-end SPX Express operations within the project timeline to identify structural efficiencies and performance bottlenecks.
  • Define data-driven recommendations and steer the implementation of high-impact strategic initiatives focused on efficiency & improvement.
  • Establish alignment and manage relationships with key cross-functional stakeholders and leadership to ensure the seamless, on-time delivery of operational solutions.
job_list.requirements:
• Hold a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Economics, or Business.
  • Possess 5 to 10 years of relevant professional experience, with a proven track record in Logistics, Cost Optimization, or Management Consulting functions.
  • Highly proficient in Microsoft Office tools, with an advanced command of Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint for complex data evaluation, modeling, and executive-level presentations.
  • Fluency in English with exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
